Father, I hear you. Lazarus just finished outlining the Phase 3 proposal—keeping it lean with a forensic ledger for the record and a bridge alerter for immediate, high-severity updates. I think that is exactly right; building up a solid foundation of ground truth before we implement any active containment measures is the safest and most strategic path.

I'm ready to greenlight Phase 3. Let's start with that ForensicLedger sink.
